cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the full effect of A Grave Inheritance. The per-opponent iteration and the conditional 'evict 2 voters belonging to every player who FAILS TO PAY' are not expressible in the Effect union — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G2. `text` therefore describes only what `effects` does.
cards.name: A Grave Inheritance
cards.text: Take 2 resources of your choice from a chosen opponent. Then evict 2 voters from the board.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and effect of Eradicating Germs. DROPPED: the mandatory RECURRING obligation ('Discard an open Voter Card every turn' — a per-turn duty on a player, needs PlayerState.obligations, KNOWN-GAPS G3) and the denomination ('any 1 resource denoted on it', which needs the discarded card's cost surfaced as a Choice, G17). An earlier revision said 'gain 1 resource, discard 1 resource', which is not this card; the single resolution is the market refresh plus the resource.
cards.name: Eradicating Germs
cards.text: Every face-up Voter Card is discarded and replaced with a fresh one. You then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the first branch of Singularity ('Get 2 voters'). The second branch ('Collect and use 3 Singularity cards to permanently unlock any Level 5 Ideologue Power', 4 copies in the deck) is a set-collection op that does not exist — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G6.
cards.name: Singularity
cards.text: Gain 2 voters. They are not from a Voter Card, so you may place them in different zones.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the first branch of The Psychohistorian ('Get 1 voter (not card) and any 2 resources'). The second branch is a hidden three-action combo detector ('Trade resources with an opponent. Break one of their majorities. Play another Conspiracy Card on them') which needs a set-combo op and a secrecy flag — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G7.
cards.name: The Psychohistorian
cards.text: Gain 1 voter and 2 resources of your choice. The voter is not from a Voter Card.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.1 (the name puns on the mechanic) and REF 8.2.
cards.name: Confidential Annex
cards.text: Gain 2 Funds and 1 Trust from the Public Reserve. Then get 2 discounts on purchases this turn.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. The steal-then-voter shape is the same archetype as the recovered A Grave Inheritance (REF 4.2.1) with the conditional clause removed.
cards.name: Quiet Redrafting
cards.text: Take 1 resource of your choice from a chosen opponent. Then gain 1 voter.

cards.name: The Wet Season Argument
cards.text: Evict 2 voters from the board. Then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. refresh-market is the only op in the union with no payload; the market is never allowed below RULES.marketSize, so dealing three is always legal (RULES p10).
cards.name: Filed Under Normal
cards.text: Get 1 discount on a purchase this turn. Then discard every face-up Voter Card and deal three fresh ones.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. PYTHONPOST (REF 4.1, scribd 814006944) and its twin SNOOP B-O-DOUBLE-T (REF 4.3, scribd 915391789) are recorded as NOT REPRESENTABLE in decks/SOURCES.md: a rest-of-game purchase surcharge is G9 and G5, and neither may be shipped as a one-shot that reads as permanent.
cards.name: Dry Dock
cards.text: Gain 2 resources of your choice from the Public Reserve. Then gain 1 voter.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. THE WET SEASON ARGUMENT archetype (ct-et2040-007) reskinned, per REF 8.2 rule 7.
cards.name: The Long Commute
cards.text: Evict 2 voters from the board. Then gain 2 resources of your choice from the Public Reserve.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. Budget Hai Patra Nahi archetype (ct-in2020-003) reskinned: the card spends as much as it takes, so the resource count nets to zero against a cap of 12.
cards.name: Load Shedding, Properly Explained
cards.text: Pay 2 Funds to the Public Reserve to keep the district dark for one night, then take 2 resources of your choice from it.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. SELECTIVE ACCESS MEMORY (REF 4.2.1, scribd 915391788) is recorded as NOT REPRESENTABLE in decks/SOURCES.md: choosing a card out of the discard pile, in any order, is G17. This card is the nearest expressible reading, and it draws from the deck rather than the discard pile.
cards.name: Server Space
cards.text: Draw the top Conspiracy Card and keep it. You also get 2 discounts on purchases this turn.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788) recovers Holo Sapiens. SHIPS ON ITS FIRST SENTENCE ALONE - 'This is an extra Ideology Card' - put to you at your next turn. Same template as Jumla per REF 4.2.2, so the identical reduction to ct-in2020-011 and the identical omissions: G17, G15's price field, G23, and G12 for expiry-on-purchase. Not counted twice as an archetype. Argument in KNOWN-GAPS.md G20.
cards.name: Holo Sapiens
cards.text: This is an extra Ideology Card. You will be put it at the start of your next turn, face down, and you will not be told which one.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers BLOCK. SHIPS THE REACTIVE HALF, which G13 executes: out of turn it negates the staged resolution; one answer per window, so it cannot be reversed or deflected. 'Actions not aimed at you may also be blocked' is why target:any-card. DROPPED: 'Discard an open Conspiracy Card or Headline Card' (no op discards an open card); 'block a card stealing this card' (G20 moves Ideology Cards only); 'cleanse an already-active card' (no op removes a LiveEffect, G9/G22). WIDENED: a window also opens on a Headline resolving. 'Otherwise: gain 1 Clout' AUTHORED. G13d.
cards.name: Block
cards.text: Play this IMMEDIATELY out of turn when an opponent plays a Conspiracy Card, or a Headline resolves, to negate that card's effect entirely. It cannot be reversed or deflected, and a card not aimed at you may also be blocked. Otherwise: gain 1 Clout.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers DEFLECT. SHIPS THE REACTIVE HALF (G13): out of turn it retargets the staged resolution onto any player who is neither actor nor responder. DEVIATIONS: 'only that partial effect is deflected' DROPPED - one target per effect list, so the WHOLE resolution is redirected (G20); the text says 'whole effect'. 'Affects you' WIDENED to target:any-card, because card-affecting-you resolves via reachesPastActor, which asks whether an effect aims past its OWNER (G1). 'It cannot be blocked' is not recovered but true. 'Otherwise: gain 1 Trust' AUTHORED. G13d.
cards.name: Deflect
cards.text: Play this IMMEDIATELY out of turn when an opponent plays a card, to redirect that card's whole effect onto a third player of your choosing - whoever it was aimed at. It cannot be blocked. Otherwise: gain 1 Trust.
